label: Payment type
hint: Pick one or more. E.g. cash + barter, or cash + % of sales.

barter.valueHint: Total in R$, optional. Helps with the invoice (barter is taxed too) and with the Projection.

performance.measurePlaceholder: E.g. coupon HERO10 or tracked link
performance.estimateHint: How much it should bring in R$, optional. Counts in the Projection.

errors.none_selected: Pick at least one payment type: cash, barter or performance.
errors.barter_offer: Describe what is offered in barter (3 to 300 characters).
errors.perf_rate: Check the performance rule: a percentage from 0.01 to 100 or an amount in R$.
errors.perf_measure: Describe how performance is tracked (e.g. coupon or link).

dealHint: Pick one or more. The cash amount is each Hero's fee, in the Heroes tab.
adminOnly: Only the Admin changes the payment type and sees the amounts.
